analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand (Elite Contender, goal: Win Championship) can leverage 21-year-old RB Jeremiyah Love (90.1 C-AVI / 95.4 D-AVI) to target 32-year-old Derrick Henry (93.1 C-AVI / 88.0 D-AVI) from Ravens Regime (Playoff Push, goal: Increase Championship Odds). Proposing Jeremiyah Love for Derrick Henry plus a 2028 2nd-round pick increases Big Balder Brand's starting RB2 scoring output for 2026 (+3.0 C-AVI / +18.3 projected PPR points) while recapturing future draft liquidity. For Ravens Regime, receiving a 21-year-old cornerstone RB who produces at a near-identical level preserves their 2026 playoff push while solving their impending RB age cliff.
